newsitem.title: BRAZIL: U.S. giants eye Brazil's oil sector - paper.
newsitem.headline: U.S. giants eye Brazil's oil sector - paper.

text.p: U.S.-based oil giants Unocal Corp and Arco International Oil & Gas Co hope to enter Brazil's oil sector, local financial daily Gazeta Mercantil said.
"We are interested in the (Brazilian) market's potential," Unocal President John Imle was quoted by the paper as saying in Washington.
Gazeta also quoted Arco International chief John Cheatham as saying: "We are not in Brazil yet but we are considering investing there if the opportunities appear."

The paper said the two men attended an international petroleum forum in Washington last week and the firms intend to be part of a business delegation travelling to the Brazilian state of Bahia in May.
